statement: For every outer cyclic order-six action on the full punctured-torus group, its exact centre-free extension has three F-conjugacy classes of involution sections cyclically permuted by the cubic quotient, and two F-conjugacy classes of cubic sections exchanged by the positive involution quotient. It has one full conjugacy class of subgroups of each prime order, no subgroup of order six, and no other nontrivial finite subgroup type. The outer order-six element has no finite-order automorphism representative, although its prescribed prime-order restrictions lift. Each prime-section normalizer is exactly the direct product of that section with its full fixed group, whose first cohomology at that prime vanishes.
depends_on: D27 actual prime-order representatives; D43 global involution sign; D46 three positive-involution section classes and their distinct elementary abelian coordinates; D48 two cubic section classes; D51 separation of their cubic character values; D54 exclusion of fixed dyadic characters for cubic actions; D55 all-prime homology faithfulness and positive-involution action minus identity
manuscript_passages: Section 30, folios 194-196, scans 383-387; Section 31, folios 198-199 verso, scans 391-394; Part D(b), finite actions and actual lifts in type (1,1)
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The extension is the displayed inverse image in Aut(F) times C6; every section has its specified quotient label. The affine coordinate maps arise from the actual elementary abelian quotients and Brown section-class comparisons. Full conjugacy, normalizers, and nonlifting are obtained from those precise actions.
notes: The dyadic cubic matrix has no fixed vector, so every associated affine action on F2 squared has one fixed point and one three-cycle. Its invariant set of three involution classes is the latter. On the two cubic classes the positive involution has affine slope minus one; their separated values force the swap. Any order-six subgroup would fix its order-two subgroup's class, contradicting the three-cycle. The first projection identifies the extension with the inverse image of the outer cyclic subgroup, and torsion-freeness of Inn(F) makes every finite-order representative of the outer generator have order six. No identification of the full extension with C2 free-product C3, no scalar-multiplier exclusion, and no geometric conjugacy assertion is made. The exact finite affine certificate is code/part_a/torus_order6_sections_d56.py.
